title: Watch Duty: The Night Watch
summary: The Watch asks you to walk the walls tonight and thin out the dead.

dialogue.intro: The Watch is short-handed tonight. The dead keep coming up to the fences.
offer: Eight of the dead put back down. Before they find a door.
Because you've stood for us before. People sleep better when they hear you're on the wall.
dialogue.return: Still walking the walls? Come back when it's quiet.
dialogue.reward: Quiet out there now. Take this, from the Watch.
dialogue.done: The night was quiet. Thanks to you.
